goals.instruction: Rogue has decided to let Glitch have the data shard. Make it his.
Glitch owes Rogue for letting him lie low. Have him pay her with his stimpak.
Mux is looking rough back there. Get Glitch's stimpak into his hands.
Rogue wants the charge cell Mux is sitting on. Make sure she ends up holding it.
Rogue should drop the data shard off with Mux so he can keep it in the back.
Send Rogue to see what's going on in the back room.
Mux has been hiding among the crates all night. Get him out to the bar.
Glitch has something for Rogue's ears only. Let him tell her without anyone else catching the words.
Rogue wants everyone in the bar to hear that she's closing early tonight.
Have Mux grumble out loud about the dead screens. He doesn't need anyone in particular to hear it.
Rogue has a warning for Mux. She should go and give it to him directly, out loud.
Have Glitch plug the data shard into his deck and crack whatever is on it.
Get Mux to repair the jammed door between the back room and the bar.
